run_kmeans_clustering: create a KMeansCluster with num_centroids and num_iterations then call fit on data to get centroids and classes
compute_nearest_centroids: call get_classes_and_distances with data and centroids to assign each point to its nearest centroid
perform_kmeans_iteration: call kmeans_iteration with data and a TrainingState to compute updated centroids for one step
extract_kmeans_output: call compute_output with data and a final TrainingState to get centroids counts std_distance and classes
initialize_kmeans_centroids: create a KMeansCluster which randomly initializes centroids from data points using a PRNG key
